findings.summary: Flagged shirt M group for Synthetic Tiruppur Loom: fit returns worsened versus the prior period and sit well above the peer level. Nearly all directional fit feedback points to garments running too large, with quotes describing loose fit at the waist and shoulders. The signal comes from returns alone, with no corroborating fit reviews.
findings.suggested_action: Ask the vendor to review the shirt M size spec and grading, prioritise clearing open fit returns, and recheck next cycle before further inventory ships.

findings.summary: Flagged kurti M group for Synthetic Bengaluru Stitch: fit returns worsened versus the prior period and sit well above peers, with a dominant too-small direction. Customers cite a tight chest with buttons straining when sitting, and fit reviews corroborate the return signal. Many returns also remain unresolved. Cited quotes are from the prior window.
findings.suggested_action: Have the vendor recheck kurti M chest and body measurements against the pattern, expedite resolution of unresolved fit returns, and confirm the issue persists in current returns.

findings.summary: Kurti M for Synthetic Jaipur Thread is not flagged and performs better than peers, but current fit returns lean too-small while a supporting review reports the opposite (too large) — mixed directional signals. Fit returns also ticked up versus the prior period. Worth watching before it becomes a pattern.
findings.suggested_action: Keep on the watchlist, verify measurement consistency across recent production lots, and reconcile the conflicting too-small and too-large feedback with the vendor.

findings.summary: Shirt M for Synthetic Surat Weave is not flagged and sits below the peer fit-return level, but nearly all directional fit feedback points too large and fit returns edged up versus the prior period. Quotes describe loose waist and shoulder fit — an early signal worth monitoring.
findings.suggested_action: Monitor next cycle and share the too-large directional feedback with the vendor as an early heads-up on the size spec before volumes grow.

findings.summary: Trousers XL for Synthetic Bengaluru Stitch is marked insufficient data — the sample is too small to judge fit performance, so no trend call should be made.
